test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A deposited Rs. 62,500 at the rate of 8% per annum compounded half yearly, then what is the compound interest at the end of two years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 62,500

Rate of interest (R) = 8% per annum compounded half yearly

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest = P(1 + R/n)ⁿt - P

Where,

P = Principal amount,

R = Annual interest rate (in decimal),

n = Number of times the interest is compounded per year,

t = Time the money is invested for in years.

**Calculation:**

Since the interest is compounded half yearly, n = 2.

R = 8% = 0.08 (in decimal)

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500(1 + 0.08/2)²×² - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500(1 + 0.04)⁴ - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500(1.04)⁴ - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500 × (1.16985856) - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 73116.16 - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = Rs. 10,616.16

**The compound interest at the end of two years is Rs. 10,616.16.**
